List configured local Drivers and their last info probe health

Usage:
  inframill driver list [flags]

Examples:
  inframill driver list --columns id,status,reason

Flags:
      --columns string   comma-separated columns: id,name,version,status,reason,checked_at
      --config string    required application YAML (default ".inframill.yaml")
  -h, --help             help for list
  -o, --output string    output format: table or json (default "table")

Global Flags:
      --color string   human output color: auto, always or never (default "auto")
